I keep finding SaaS I forgot I was paying for.

So I tried my hands at building @bot that reads my Gmail receipts, scores the mess, and opens a HTML autopsy.

Receipt Reaper. Read-only. It does not cancel anything unless I say so.https://t.co/atpTP7x63q pic.twitter.com/TWPifIwjT0

— RealJBMangum (@RealJBMangum) September 12, 2026
